item_name: Failure to Complete Annual Performance Evaluation
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The audit criteria for Area 24 reference an "annual performance evaluation" but the document does not state an assessor observation/look-back window in days for this item.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the required annual performance evaluation is missing or incomplete, the claim will be disallowed.

source.quote: If the required annual performance evaluation is missing or incomplete, the claim will be disallowed.

federal_coding_rules.rule: This audit protocol applies to ALP service dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025.

federal.criterion: An annual performance evaluation must be present and complete in the record for the individual providing service; a missing or incomplete evaluation results in claim disallowance.

source.quote: If the required annual performance evaluation is missing or incomplete, the claim will be disallowed.

federal.notes: Stated as OMIG Audit Criteria for Area 24; the document does not specify which elements make an evaluation "complete."

state_deltas.delta: New York OMIG audit protocol for the Assisted Living Program treats a missing or incomplete required annual performance evaluation as a basis for disallowing the claim, citing 10 NYCRR § 763.13(h), 10 NYCRR § 766.11(g), 18 NYCRR § 494.3(b), and 18 NYCRR § 505.14(f)(1) and (2).

source.quote: Regulatory References 10 NYCRR § 763.13(h) 10 NYCRR § 766.11(g) 18 NYCRR § 494.3(b) 18 NYCRR § 505.14(f)(1) and (2)

case_mix_relevance.notes: The document does not tie Area 24 to any payment or case-mix classification; it states only that the claim will be disallowed.
